amendment.exposure: Authors saw A3 sources, previous brief and exploratory value-pilot output. Five count expectations are known constants. New count source is prepared and hashed but NOT RUN at registration. No full campaign has run.
amendment.reason: Before the 1107-input campaign, freeze explicit subclaim refutation/non-refutation rules with examples; add literal DAG count probes; separate blinded raw-oracle, algorithm-reimplementation and proof-review roles.

amendments: New version plus parent hash, reason, time and exposure statement; never rewrite the old registration or relabel exploratory results as preregistered.

budget.derived_runs_accounting: The per-base CPU budget includes all checks and its reversal/coordinate-swap derived runs.
budget.on_timeout: INCOMPLETE_NOT_PASS; no skipped case silently counted as agreement

candidate_acceptance: Use the frozen refutation_policy. One discrepancy opens a candidate; mathematical refutation, software defect and proof gap are distinct verdicts with exact target and independence limits.
continuation_diagnostic: Within each fixed input and every reachable count-vector q-group, compare endpoint-event trace languages with class ID and atom/start/finish labels after suppressing q-stutters, and their max-width costs. Raw suffix-language and exact atomic strong-bisimulation failures are classified diagnostics, not automatic A3 value failures.

count_smoke.observed_method: Enumerate literal singleton atom / repeated start-finish states and unique directed edges; do not derive observed counts from formula. Serialize every vertex/edge and forward/reverse BFS sets. Counts concern the unfiltered admissible DAG.
count_smoke.pass_rule: All five observed vertex/edge counts match fixed constants, all unrestricted vertices reachable and co-reachable, and all 15 tamper controls reject.
count_smoke.reference_dp_instrumentation_gate: Future independent/reference DP must expose its actual allocated/admissible/reachable states and executed legal transition set. Compare sets and unique counts with literal checker for each fixed probe and every scheduled campaign input. This standalone smoke checker does not itself run or validate the reference DP.
count_smoke.run_order: Commit and read back this V2 registration and its digest before first count-smoke execution and before code/receipt release.
count_smoke.scientific_status_ceiling: Only after a successful run: at most AUTHOR_SESSION_SELF_VERIFIED_HARNESS_QUALITY_ONLY; not external inspection, replication or general formula proof.

domain: For each p in F, d=0..D, k=1..K: all k-element sets of pairwise distinct subspaces of GF(p)^d; include zero and full subspaces.
equivalent_profile_check: All ordered positive vectors a with sum(a)<=M; for fixed k there must be binomial(M,k) vectors.
expansion_rule: For every capped layout perform one canonical expansion: insert a_j-2 middle copies immediately after class j first endpoint; verify every cut and original multiplicities. All full layouts are separately covered by projection checks.
geometry_enumeration: All subspaces as explicit vector sets, lexicographically sorted; zero and full belong to the universe, not necessarily every selected arrangement; all k-combinations; no GL(d,p) quotient and no geometric sampling.
metamorphic_schedule: For every base instance also reverse class labels and, when d=2, swap vector coordinates; compare invariant optima and validate remapped witnesses. Log separately from 1107 base instances.
multiplicity_enumeration: For n=k..M enumerate every integer partition of n into k positive parts and every distinct assignment/permutation of those parts to the canonically ordered classes.
oracle: Enumerate all full multiset class words at original multiplicities; evaluate every cut by explicit left/right vector-set spans and intersection cardinality; no q, endpoint transition code, rank identity, JANUS import or reference outputs.
receipt_not_applicable_rule: For graph-count, proof-gap or other non-value findings, optimum/witness/cut fields may be explicit NOT_APPLICABLE with reason; never invent numeric values to satisfy the receipt schema.

mathematical_refutations.consequence: Refutes this pathwise subclaim; optimum consequence separately UNDETERMINED.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical: a legal sigma has a normalized support pair absent from its computed C(sigma). Supply both traces, class spans and exact input; no actual such example is claimed.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: One valid full layout with a different normalized support-pair trace after exact first/last deletion.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: For any legal full layout, deletion of middle occurrences preserves its ordered cut support-pair trace up to consecutive duplicates.

mathematical_refutations.consequence: Pathwise lemma refuted; optimum theorem assessed separately.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical direct W(sigma)=2,W(C(sigma))=1, each exact cut checked. This refutes pathwise preservation even if both global optima coincide.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: One legal full layout and its prescribed compression with unequal direct maximum cut widths.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: W(C(sigma))=W(sigma) for every legal full layout.

mathematical_refutations.consequence: This pathwise subclaim refuted; optimum consequence assessed separately.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical full cut-value set {0,1,2} versus compressed {0,2}; equal maxima do not rescue the named set-preservation claim.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: One valid full layout and its prescribed compression with unequal independently checked cut-width value sets, even if maxima agree.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: The set of cut-width values of a legal full layout equals that of its exact first/last compression.
mathematical_refutations.target: Compression theorem compression_statement cut-width value-set preservation

mathematical_refutations.consequence: Named pathwise expansion invariant refuted; expansion existence and optimum adjudicated separately.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical legal between-endpoint insertion changes a side-span pair or width set. This refutes that invariant even if another lift still attains equal width.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: One legal source-conforming insertion with a directly verified failure of the named span/width invariant; validate endpoint order, copy counts and between-endpoint positions first.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: Inserting only the required middle copies strictly between their own first and last endpoints preserves normalized side-span trace and cut-width values.

mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical endpoint width 1 while every full lift has width at least 2. Failure of one chosen decoder alone is insufficient.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: One endpoint order for which exhaustive/certified search of all legal lifts proves none has equal width.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: Every legal endpoint order has a full legal lift at the prescribed multiplicities with the same width.

mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical certified minima 2 versus 1. Two layouts of widths 2 and 1 do not suffice.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: Different exact minima on the same valid raw geometry, with complete enumerations or independently checked upper/lower certificates.

mathematical_refutations.consequence: Frozen algorithmic subclaim refuted; a bug in a non-faithful implementation is not enough.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical faithfully evaluated frozen recurrence returns 2 while exhaustive legal endpoint orders attain minimum 1.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: Mismatch after validating faithful recurrence/transitions and independently enumerating endpoint layouts.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: The exact frozen recurrence over the specified legal DAG returns the minimum endpoint-layout bottleneck width.

mathematical_refutations.consequence: Exact counting subclaim refuted; optimum consequence separately UNDETERMINED.
mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical complete graph for (2,2) has 9 states and 11 legal edges rather than 12; showing a buggy generator omitted an edge only refutes that generator.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: A complete, independently verified legal vertex/edge set at a valid multiplicity profile has a different count.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: Unique states and legal directed edges equal the stated mixed-state formulas.
mathematical_refutations.target: Exact unfiltered admissible endpoint-DAG state/edge counts

mathematical_refutations.example: Hypothetical direct intersection dimension 1 while verified ranks yield 2; field/arithmetic defects eliminated first.
mathematical_refutations.falsifier: Valid finite-field geometry/cut with exact independently checked unequal sides.
mathematical_refutations.predicate: Direct dim(L intersect R)=rho(S)+rho(I minus P)-rho(I) at every admissible cut.

refutation_policy.no_posthoc_escape: A mismatch may not be rejected solely by calling it bisimulation-only if it also satisfies any named pathwise, optimum, expansion, rank or count falsifier. Preserve all allegations and reasons. New decision rules require a prospectively hashed amendment; never retroactively exclude an observed counterexample.

non_refutations.example: a=(3,1),c=(1,0),c_prime=(2,0): same endpoint Active/NotStarted; next class-1 target Active versus Done.
non_refutations.rule: Exact atomic strong bisimulation failure alone is diagnostic, not A3 refutation.

non_refutations.example: One representative needs two remaining class-1 occurrences and another needs one; compare normalized endpoint traces separately.
non_refutations.rule: Different raw suffix word lengths/multiplicities alone are diagnostic.

non_refutations.example: For one repeated line, cut arrays [0,1,1,0] and [0,1,0] have different sums but equal maxima 1.
non_refutations.rule: Additive sums, trace lengths or number of cuts do not replace min-max width.

non_refutations.example: A missing middle-copy self-loop, or fewer edges after filtering by width<=B, does not contradict the unfiltered DAG count formula.
non_refutations.rule: Original occurrence edges, q-stuttering loops and width-filtered graphs are not the complete unfiltered endpoint DAG.

non_refutations.example: Word 112 is not a full layout for multiplicities (3,1).
non_refutations.rule: Missing/extra copies or illegal precedence are rejected as candidate evidence.

non_refutations.example: A generator that deletes one legal edge for (2,2) yields 11; repairing that omission removes the discrepancy.
non_refutations.rule: Unfaithful transitions, bad arithmetic or a broken witness decoder are software defects until linked to a frozen mathematical subclaim.

non_refutations.example: An argument assumes an unsupported equivalence; report the exact gap and independent status, without inventing a counterexample.
non_refutations.rule: An unproved inference may invalidate a proof route without proving the theorem false.

non_refutations.example: An earlier equivalent exact algorithm is found and mapped to the same hypotheses.
non_refutations.rule: A directly subsuming theorem concerns novelty and does not by itself disprove values.

non_refutations.example: Different tied optimal words both validate at width 1; byte mismatch alone is irrelevant to optimum.
non_refutations.rule: Timeouts, missing coverage, hash mismatches or differing valid optimal witnesses do not establish mathematical refutation.

refutation_policy.scope_rule: Separate OUTSIDE_CAMPAIGN_BOUNDS from OUTSIDE_THEOREM_DOMAIN. A valid exploratory counterexample beyond K,D,F,M may refute the universal frozen target, but is not confirmatory coverage of the 1107 set.
refutation_policy.unlisted_case_default: PENDING_SOURCE_MAPPING; never automatic rejection merely because unlisted, never automatic theorem refutation.
refutation_policy.validation_gate: Name exact target proposition/SHA, validate raw domain and completeness, replay with a separately authored method, eliminate implementation/model/objective mismatch, publish evidence and exposure. Final external validation requires a reviewer genuinely independent of the original/reference and oracle authors. Same-session checks remain SELF_VERIFIED and pending that gate.

release_order: Preserve V1 immutable bytes; publish V2 amendment with parent hash and all verdict/count/spec-role rules before campaign or count-smoke run.
publish exact preregistration UTF-8 LF bytes and SHA-256 commitment in immutable commit
archive commit URL and timestamp; obtain independent timestamp/countersignature if possible
independent implementer freezes code and fixture manifest before seeing reference outputs
publish implementation and run receipts, including negative and incomplete results

specification_roles.adjudicator: Separate independent human/expert and exact checker; same-session authors cannot self-assign external status.
specification_roles.dp_packet: Complete frozen theorem and transition specification, but no reference code or answers before freeze. Tests independent algorithm implementation, not independent discovery of lemma.
specification_roles.not_underdetermined: Original optimization task is fully determined. Independence from compression is achieved by excluding it from raw-oracle assumptions, not by omitting necessary problem definitions.
specification_roles.proof_review_packet: Original task plus explicitly named compression claim; reviewer derives a valid argument or counterexample. For independent derivation withhold frozen proof text until reviewer freezes argument/exposure declaration.

raw_oracle_packet.contains: Fully specified original task only, no q/compression lemma/endpoint recurrence/formula/expected outputs. No duty to derive compression.

stop_rule: Preserve the first discrepancy and minimal reproduction immediately; continue in-domain cases if budget permits. A complete no-refutation report requires every scheduled check completed and adjudicated, not equality in stronger-property diagnostics; a validated refutation needs one case.
